questions.en: Who is not the winner of the Ramon Magsaysay Award 2026?

questions.en: On 30 August 2026, NASA launched which spacecraft with the help of SpaceX's Falcon Heavy rocket to study the mysteries of dark matter and dark energy?
questions.pa: 30 ਅਗਸਤ 2026 ਨੂੰ NASA ਨੇ ਡਾਰਕ ਮੈਟਰ ਅਤੇ ਡਾਰਕ ਐਨਰਜੀ ਦੇ ਰਹੱਸਾਂ ਦਾ ਅਧਿਐਨ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ SpaceX ਦੇ Falcon Heavy ਰਾਕੇਟ ਦੀ ਮਦਦ ਨਾਲ ਕਿਹੜਾ ਅੰਤਰਿਕਸ਼ ਯਾਨ ਲਾਂਚ ਕੀਤਾ?

questions.en: Who is not inducted into the Tennis Hall of Fame? He is from which country?

questions.en: What status has India got in the Global Combat Air Programme (GCAP)?

questions.en: Renowned footballer Lionel Messi has announced his retirement from international football. He hails from which country?

questions.en: Prime Minister Narendra Modi was awarded the 'Order of Oliy Darajali Do'stlik', the highest state honour of which country?

questions.en: With which country has India signed an agreement to purchase the Javelin Anti-Tank Guided Missile System?

questions.en: When was National Sports Day celebrated?
